description.value: Sushi Waa is a sushi restaurant located in a commercial unit on Tenth Street in Nanaimo. It offers takeout alongside dine-in service and provides online ordering through a dedicated menu platform. Cycling visitors passing through Nanaimo's south end will find it a straightforward stop for Japanese cuisine.
